mapper.select: SELECT tct.name AS train_car_type_name,tc.train_car_number,s.seat_number,s.seat_column,ps.code_token FROM T_PurchasedSeat AS ps INNER JOIN M_TrainCar AS tc ON ps.train_car_cd=tc.train_car_cd AND ps.purchase_id=#{purchase_id} INNER JOIN M_Seat AS s ON ps.seat_cd=s.seat_cd INNER JOIN M_SeatType AS st ON s.seat_type_cd=st.seat_type_cd INNER JOIN M_TrainCarType AS tct ON st.train_car_type_cd=tct.train_car_type_cd ORDER BY tc.train_car_number,s.seat_number,s.seat_column;
